title.ko: because of · due to · owing to · as a result · consequently · so … that
title.en: because of · due to · owing to · as a result · consequently · so … that

explain.ko: 원인과 결과를 연결하는 표현은 문법 구조가 다릅니다. 명사 앞에서는 because of, due to, owing to를 씁니다(owing to heavy snow). 절 앞에서는 because, since, as를 씁니다(because it snowed). 결과를 나타내는 연결 부사는 as a result, consequently, therefore, thus이며 앞 문장과 구분해 쓰고 뒤에 쉼표를 붙입니다. so + 형용사 + that, such + 명사 + that은 정도와 결과를 한 문장에 담습니다(so tired that I fell asleep). lead to와 result in 뒤에는 명사가 오고 원인이 앞에 옵니다.
explain.en: Cause and result linkers have different grammar. Before a noun use because of, due to, owing to (owing to heavy snow). Before a clause use because, since, as (because it snowed). Result adverbs are as a result, consequently, therefore, thus; they start a new sentence and are followed by a comma. So + adjective + that and such + noun + that combine degree and result (so tired that I fell asleep). Lead to and result in are followed by a noun, with the cause first.

head: 구조 / Structure
형태 / Form
예문 / Example
rows: because of / due to / owing to + noun
Owing to the snow, we stayed home.
We stayed home because it snowed.
It snowed. As a result, we stayed home.
so + adj + that / such + noun + that
It was so cold that we stayed home.

notes.ko: because of 뒤에는 절이 아니라 명사가 옵니다. because of it snowed(×)
notes.en: Because of takes a noun, not a clause: because of it snowed is wrong.

notes.ko: due to는 be 동사 뒤에, owing to는 문장 앞에 자주 씁니다.
notes.en: Due to often follows be; owing to often starts a sentence.

notes.ko: therefore, consequently는 접속사가 아니므로 문장을 나눠야 합니다.
notes.en: Therefore and consequently are adverbs, not conjunctions.

task.model: Owing to heavy snow, many flights were cancelled yesterday. It snowed so much that the airport closed. As a result, thousands of passengers spent the night at the airport. Consequently, the airline has arranged extra flights today.

model_trans.ko: 폭설 때문에 어제 많은 항공편이 취소되었습니다. 눈이 너무 많이 와서 공항이 문을 닫았습니다. 그 결과 수천 명의 승객이 공항에서 밤을 보냈습니다. 따라서 항공사는 오늘 추가 편을 마련했습니다.
model_trans.en: Owing to heavy snow, many flights were cancelled yesterday. It snowed so much that the airport closed. As a result, thousands of passengers spent the night at the airport. Consequently, the airline has arranged extra flights today.
